title: Set Matrix Zeroes
description:
Given an `m x n` integer matrix, if an element is `0`, set its **entire row and column** to `0`. Do it **in place**.

The function returns nothing: the test checks the matrix you modified.
hints: Record which rows and columns contain a zero before changing anything, otherwise new zeroes will cause extra clearing.
To use O(1) extra space, store the markers in the first row and first column (and remember separately whether those themselves had a zero).
